about: Unsettled Tom is a crude MS Paint-style extreme close-up of Tom from Tom and Jerry: huge round yellow eyes, tense eyebrows and stress lines on his forehead, staring off to the side in quiet distress. He is not panicking or screaming; he is simply disturbed and trying to process what he just saw. That restraint is what makes the image useful: it is the face you make when someone casually says something deeply wrong. Captions describe the cursed statement, habit or fact, and Tom silently reacts to it.
origin: The drawing comes from a fan-made Paint comic posted on DeviantArt in the early 2010s, and later spread as a reaction image on 4chan and then Reddit around 2019.
usage:
Use the top box for the setup ("when your friend says", "me hearing"), and the bottom box for the cursed thing itself. Quote the statement directly when you can; the more casually horrifying it is, the better Tom's stare works.

Good targets: cursed food combos, alarming confessions, chaotic habits, and things that are technically true but upsetting to learn. The quieter and more matter-of-fact the caption, the funnier Tom's silent horror becomes.
ideas: "I don't wash my legs, the water runs down"
"I don't use headphones on the bus"
